drhp.business: Walpar Nutritions Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and trading of Pharmaceutical, Nutraceutical, Herbal and Ayurvedic commodities. demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- Growing consumer awareness regarding preventive healthcare, nutrition, immunity, healthy lifestyles and overall well-being is supporting demand for nutraceuticals, dietary supplements, herbal products and functional nutrition.
- Expansion of organised retail, growth of e-commerce and greater consumer acceptance of preventive healthcare and traditional systems of medicine are benefiting the healthcare, pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, herbal and Ayurvedic sectors in India.
- Increasing adoption of digital channels and growing interest in nutritional and wellness products provide opportunities for companies in the healthcare and wellness segment.
- Management expects growing consumer awareness regarding health and wellness, increasing demand for nutraceutical products and expansion of digital healthcare platforms to create significant business opportunities.
